'''''Kalanchoe laetivirens''''' is a species of ''[[Kalanchoe]]'' (section ''[[Bryophyllum]]''). It was thought to be a [[Hybrid (biology)|hybrid]] between ''[[Kalanchoe daigremontiana|K. daigremontiana]]'' and ''[[Kalanchoe laxiflora|K. laxiflora]]'' (syn. ''Bryophyllum crenatum''), and therefore a group of invalid names for such a hybrid, including '''''Kalanchoe crenodaigremontiana''''', '''''Kalanchoe crenato-daigremontiana''''', '''''Bryophyllum crenodaigremontianum''''' and '''''Bryophyllum crenato-daigremontianum''''', are just synonyms of ''K. laetivirens''.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Smith|first=Gideon F.|date=2020-09-21|title=Taxonomy and nomenclature of ''Kalanchoe'' ×''laetivirens'' (Crassulaceae subfam. Kalanchooideae), a further invasive nothospecies from Madagascar|url=https://www.biotaxa.org/Phytotaxa/article/view/phytotaxa.460.1.6|journal=Phytotaxa|language=en|volume=460|issue=1|pages=97–109|doi=10.11646/phytotaxa.460.1.6|issn=1179-3163|url-access=subscription}}</ref> However, their true hybrid is distinct from this species.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Shtein |first=Ronen |last2=Smith |first2=Gideon F. |last3=Ikeda |first3=Jun |date=2021-11-09 |title=Aspects of the taxonomy of the ''Kalanchoe daigremontiana'' species complex (Crassulaceae subfam. Kalanchooideae) and associated interspecific hybrids in southern Madagascar, with the description of a new nothospecies, ''K''. ×descoingsii (=''K. laetivirens'' × ''K. tubiflora'') |url=https://phytotaxa.mapress.com/pt/article/view/phytotaxa.524.4.2 |journal=Phytotaxa |volume=524 |issue=4 |pages=235–260 |doi=10.11646/phytotaxa.524.4.2 |issn=1179-3163|url-access=subscription }}</ref>

It is often misidentified as one of its putative parents, ''[[Kalanchoe daigremontiana|K. daigremontiana]]'', which has bands or spots on the back of leaves, while the leaves of ''K. laetivirens'' are completely green, as indicated by its epithet ''laetivirens'' which means "lushly green".<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Shaw|first=J.M.H.|date=2008|title=An investigation of the cultivated ''Kalanchoe daigremontiana'' group, with a checklist of ''Kalanchoe'' cultivars|url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/about-the-rhs/pdfs/publications/hanburyana/vol-3-june-2008/an-investigation-of-the-cultivated-kalanchoe.pdf|journal=Hanburyana|volume=3|pages=17–79}}</ref>
